classes.name: ShoppingCategoryController
classes.description: Spring MVC Controller for handling shop category pages, including category display, subcategory listing, manufacturers, and product retrieval with filtering and caching.

methods.name: displayCategoryWithReference
methods.description: Handles requests for category pages with a reference parameter, delegates to displayCategory.

methods.name: displayCategoryNoReference
methods.description: Handles requests for category pages without a reference, delegates to displayCategory.

methods.name: displayCategory
methods.description: Core method that retrieves category details, builds breadcrumbs, fetches subcategories and manufacturers, and prepares the model for rendering the category page.

methods.name: getManufacturersByProductAndCategory
methods.description: Fetches manufacturers associated with products in a given category, utilizing cache if enabled.

methods.name: getManufacturers
methods.description: Retrieves manufacturer details for a list of product IDs.

methods.name: getProductsByCategory
methods.description: Counts products grouped by subcategory, supporting dynamic category hierarchies.

methods.name: getSubCategories
methods.description: Retrieves subcategories of a given category, including product counts, and returns them as readable proxies.

methods.name: getCategories
methods.description: REST endpoint returning all categories for a store and language, used for category navigation.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: REST endpoint returning products belonging to a category, with optional filtering by manufacturer.
